name: Pinball quantile loss
description: Quantile regression for prediction [...,Q], target [...]; averages all sample and quantile terms by default.

parameters.quantiles: nonempty sorted sequence in (0,1), matching final prediction dimension

examples.title: Train quantile regression with pinball loss
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root=tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
 x=torch.randn(6,generator=ctx.rng.torch)
 return {"inputs":synth.Tensor(x),"targets":synth.Tensor(x[0])}
ds=synth.Spec("pinball",generator=samples,size=16,splits={"train":0.75,"val":0.25},seed=11,root=root,monitor="none").run()
train=ds.for_recipe("regression",split="train",input_field="inputs",target_field="targets",preserve_shape=True)
val=ds.for_recipe("regression",split="val",like=train,input_field="inputs",target_field="targets",preserve_shape=True)
model=build("mlp","tiny",in_features=6,out_features=3)
trainer=Trainer(model,train,val,recipe="regression",recipe_config={"loss":"pinball","loss_kwargs":{"quantiles":[0.1,0.5,0.9]}},max_epochs=1,device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
result=trainer.evaluate(val)
